name: codictate
description: Local, private voice dictation for macOS and Windows.

scripts.dev:hmr: bun run build:native && concurrently "bun run hmr" "bun run start"
scripts.dev:windows: bun run build:native:windows-helper && vite build && electrobun dev --watch
scripts.build:all: bun run build:stable && bun run build:canary
scripts.build:stable: bun run build:native && vite build && CODICTATE_CHANNEL=stable electrobun build --env=stable
scripts.build:canary: bun run build:native && vite build && CODICTATE_CHANNEL=canary electrobun build --env=canary
scripts.check:native:windows-helper: cargo fmt --check --manifest-path native/CodictateWindowsHelper/Cargo.toml && cargo check --manifest-path native/CodictateWindowsHelper/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --manifest-path native/CodictateWindowsHelper/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path native/CodictateWindowsHelper/Cargo.toml
scripts.start: bun run build:native && vite build && CODICTATE_CHANNEL=dev electrobun dev
scripts.start:windows: bun run build:native:windows-helper && vite build && CODICTATE_CHANNEL=dev electrobun dev
